entries.summary: DSH requires Node.js 24.9 or newer; the Node 22.19 line is no longer supported for npm installs, source checkouts, and the Python SDK's explicit node runtime mode.
entries.fix: Upgrade the Node.js used to start DSH to >=24.9, update CI/container/dev pins, and confirm `node --version`. Packaged desktop apps and the bundled Python SDK runtime ship their own Node.

entries.summary: Agent Teams sends new messages directly to the target Agent inbox; send_message returns only { sent: true }, exposes no message id or queued/accepted status, and maxPendingMessagesPerMember is removed.
entries.fix: Drain and confirm pending Team mail before upgrading, resend required undelivered messages explicitly, remove maxPendingMessagesPerMember, and read the sent field instead of message ids or delivery statuses.

entries.summary: Team-specific spawn_teammate, Team-scoped send_message/list_agents/interrupt_agent, and ctx.agentTeams creation/messaging APIs are removed; Team members use standard subagent tools, addressed at this release by agent_id and Session id (later renamed to agent in 0.2.2-alpha.3).
entries.fix: Replace spawn_teammate with subagent/subagent_fork and Team-scoped calls with the standard control tools (at this release send_message({ agent_id }); see the 0.2.2-alpha.3 subagent-names entry for the later agent argument), move interrupt:false to tool-subagent-control, resume the root Session, and re-read tasks after wait_agent.

entries.summary: The mixed `both` tool-presentation mode and DSH_TOOLS_MODE=both are rejected; `mode` accepts only `native` or `ptc`, and ctx.tools.presentAs('both') must be replaced.
entries.fix: Choose mode: native (direct tool calls) or mode: ptc (run_code plus generated SDK) in cordis.yml/overlays, replace DSH_TOOLS_MODE=both, and update presentAs('both') callers.

entries.summary: The Python PTC runtime package, Python-specific SDK renderers (jsonSchemaToPy/renderToolsSdkPy), and external Python PtcRuntime providers are removed; custom compositions must use the Node/TypeScript PTC runtime.
entries.fix: Replace the Python runtime row with @deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node (and fs/subprocess providers), remove Python SDK renderer imports, rewrite run_code programs as TypeScript, and re-enable workflows only if wanted.

entries.summary: The office-render, office-recalculate, and office-export-pdf skills and the skill-office `node`/`cli` keys are removed; Office operations now use the skill-activated office_render, office_convert, and office_recalculate tools.
entries.fix: Load the `office` router skill and call the matching Office tool, remove node/cli and DSH_BUNDLED_OFFICE_CLI/NODE, add a tool-office row to saved standard/ptc presets, and rename DSH_BUNDLED_PRIMARY_RUNTIME to DSH_PRIMARY_RUNTIME.

entries.summary: The Office conversion provider moved from @deepseek-ai/dsh-office-to-pdf to @deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit, renaming the office-to-pdf row, ctx.officeToPdf, officeToPdf/render and /generation Remote methods, and OfficeToPdf* exports.
entries.fix: Change the cordis row to id office-kit and name @deepseek-ai/dsh-office-kit, swap dependency/imports, rename ctx.officeKit, Remote methods, and OfficeKit* types, and handle OfficeKitError code `unavailable` at conversion time.

entries.summary: Cordis 4.0.0-rc.12 removes ctx.root and renames Service.config/resolveConfig to Service.metadata/resolveIntercept; inject precedence, ctx.isolate() fallback, Config.merge, and ctx.parallel() error behavior also change.
entries.fix: Use ctx[Context.root] (or Symbol.for('cordis.root')), declare [Service.metadata], call [Service.resolveIntercept](), move Config.merge to [Service.mergeIntercept](), re-provide services under ctx.isolate(), and handle AggregateError.

entries.summary: Loader 1.0.0-rc.8 removes EntryTree.write() in favor of commit(change); Include 1.1.1 persists runtime edits through a journal, applyEntryPatches always clones, and root-Include self-disposal no longer survives restart.
entries.fix: Implement commit(change) in EntryTree subclasses, treat applyEntryPatches output as the only mutable copy, await include.flush() after runtime edits, and stop relying on patched bundle rows persisting through a restart.

entries.summary: Subagent tools now address agents by name: send_message/interrupt_agent take `agent`, subagent/subagent_fork/subagent_oar accept `name`, list_agents rows change, Team tasks use `owner`, and subagent/catalog payload v3 blocks older DSH from opening the Session store.
entries.fix: Rename agent_id to agent, parse name/status/description, read owner instead of ownerId, set SubagentActivation.name, and upgrade every process that opens the Session store before creating subagents.

entries.summary: modelSelectionSettings is renamed modelSelection, list_subagent_models discovery requires modelDiscovery:true on one instance per scope, the /list-agents export is removed, and one tool-subagent-control row registers send_message, interrupt_agent, and list_agents together.
entries.fix: Rename the config key, enable modelDiscovery on one delegation instance per tool scope, replace /list-agents rows with a single tool-subagent-control row, and use tool restrictions to hide individual tools.

entries.summary: ctx.subagents removes drainChildren, listChildren, and list; direct-child catalogs must be observed through ctx.sessionQuery, and provider names can no longer be enumerated.
entries.fix: Await the exact activation.dispose() to release an execution, use drainDescendants([root]) to close a tree, read observation.projections.values.subagentCatalog for direct children, and use getProvider(name) instead of list().

entries.summary: PROFILE_TEMPLATES, ProfileTemplate, DEFAULT_PROFILE_BUNDLES, OPTIONAL_BUNDLES, ON_DEMAND_BUNDLES, OFFICIAL_ON_DEMAND_CATALOG, and OfficialBundleCatalogEntry moved from @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot to @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles with unchanged values and types.
entries.fix: Add @deepseek-ai/dsh-official-bundles to each importing package, change only the moved imports, keep initProfile/loadProfile from dsh-app-boot, and run the type check or build.

entries.summary: Plugin compatibility now reads an own engines.dsh range first and only falls back to @deepseek-ai/dsh peer ranges when engines.dsh is absent; workspace: values are invalid in engines.dsh, and refusal records rename peers to requirements.
entries.fix: Make engines.dsh cover every supported DSH release (or remove it), replace workspace: values, and read requirements instead of peers from IncompatiblePlugin and PluginCompatibility.

entries.summary: BundleInfo.updatable is replaced by the optional BundleInfo.update ('registry' or 'git'), and ManagementError adds the unexpected-package code.
entries.fix: Test bundle.update === 'registry' for listVersions, bundle.update !== undefined for updateBundle, and handle unexpected-package when switching exhaustively over ManagementError codes.

entries.summary: Internal helper values are removed from the plugin roots of dsh-file-reference-local, dsh-llm-pi-ai, and dsh-lsp-stdio; brand constructors, package subpaths, and persisted Session formats are unchanged.
entries.fix: Stop importing the listed helpers from package roots, use the injected fileReferences/lsp services or documented subpaths (FILE_REFERENCE_PROMPT from dsh-file-reference, grammar from dsh-file-reference/grammar), and run tests under Node.

entries.summary: The experimental bundle label and guide were renamed from 'Custom plugin markets' back to 'Custom plugin indexes' on 2026-10-22; the plugin_market tool and index JSON format are unchanged.
entries.fix: Update UI-label assertions, screenshots, and documentation that say 'plugin market'; no config or API migration is required.
